prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the back view: the camera stands at the centre of the back wall, at eye level, facing the front wall, turned 180 degrees from Image 2, so the left wall is at the right edge of the frame and the right wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room. The living room of a small but bright, clean and stylish present-day one-bedroom downtown apartment, with white walls, a pale oak floor and warm modern-minimalist décor. Back wall: on its left half, a large floor-to-ceiling window with sheer linen curtains looking out over the city skyline; by day, sunlight streams in through it from behind, and by night the city lights glow through it. On the right half of the back wall is the white panelled bedroom door, the only bedroom. Left wall: the apartment's front door, a dark-grey panelled door with a brass handle, which is the way in, with wall hooks and a slim oak shoe bench beside it. Right wall: a compact open kitchenette with white flat-front cabinets, a pale stone counter and two oak stools tucked under the counter's overhang. Front wall (behind the camera): low oak bookshelves. A charcoal-grey linen three-seat couch stands in the middle of the room, slightly left of centre, its back to the camera, facing the back wall's window, with a brass arc floor lamp at its left end and a low round oak coffee table in front of it. A small round light-oak dining table with two upholstered chairs stands in the right half of the room, between the couch and the kitchenette, nearer the bedroom door. A glass globe pendant lamp hangs over the dining table. At night the warm floor lamp from the left and the pendant over the table are the light sources; by day the window on the back wall gives soft, bright light.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
